color.activeProject: Highlight color for the active project name in the Project Hub list
cfg.port: Local HTTP server port for receiving completion notifications. If changed, agent hooks must be reinstalled.
cfg.claudeCommand: (Legacy) Override for the claude agent launch command. Use projectHub.agents instead.
cfg.claudeCommand.deprecated: Edit the command of the claude entry in projectHub.agents instead.
cfg.agents: AI agents to use. Each item: id (unique identifier), label (display name), command (new-session command), resumeCommand (resume-last-session command; omit if unsupported), resumeSessionCommand (resume-specific-session command template; {sessionId} is substituted).
cfg.defaultAgent: Agent id used for auto-start on switch and for the default terminal button.
cfg.focusTerminal: When switching projects, also reveal a terminal belonging to that project (its agent terminal, or any terminal whose working directory is inside the project).
cfg.switchOnRowClick: Clicking a row under a project (agent status, usage) or a service row switches to that project first, so the Explorer matches the terminal you just opened. Turn off to inspect another project without changing the Explorer.
cfg.autoInstallHooks: Automatically install completion-notification hooks when opening an agent terminal if they are missing.
cfg.autoStart: When switching projects, automatically start a Claude terminal if the project has none (restores the last conversation with --continue when available).
cfg.restoreEditors: When switching projects, close the previous project's editor tabs and restore the tabs that were last open in the target project.
cfg.terminalsInEditor: Open agent terminals as editor tabs instead of the bottom panel. Makes grid layouts easier when watching multiple agents.
cfg.splitAgentTerminals: When a project already has an agent terminal open, open the next agent split beside it so both are visible at once.
cfg.projectTerminalGrid: Show only the active project's agent terminals, arranged in a grid in the editor area. Other projects' terminals are moved to the (closed) bottom panel and keep running. When on, splitAgentTerminals and terminalsInEditor are ignored.
cfg.resumeAgentsOnRestart: After VS Code is fully restarted, agent terminals come back as plain shells. Re-run each agent there, resuming its last (or that terminal's) session.
cfg.showAllProcesses: Show all agent-internal processes (MCP servers, helpers) in the background process list. By default only processes with listening ports or launched directly from the terminal are shown.
cfg.fileTreeExclude: Names to hide in a project's Files tree. Matched against the file or folder name exactly (not a glob), case-insensitively.
cfg.windowColor: Change the title bar color to the project's identification color on switch. (Off by default — the active project is highlighted in the list.)
cfg.notifyActive: Also show notifications for the active project's completed work (only when the window is unfocused).
cfg.notificationTimeout: Auto-hide notification toasts after N seconds. Hidden notifications remain in the notification center (bell icon), so 'Switch to Project' can still be clicked later. 0 keeps toasts until closed manually.
